summary: Multiplies input 1 and input 2, with transform-page controls for fitting, aligning, extending, and transforming the overlay input before compositing.

key_params.name: prefit
key_params.note: fill, fithorz, fitvert, fitbest, fitoutside, or nativeres

key_params.name: justifyh
key_params.note: left, center, or right overlay alignment

key_params.name: justifyv
key_params.note: bottom, center, or top overlay alignment

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: hold, zero, repeat, or mirror overlay sampling

common_gotchas: Fixed Layer does not change the multiply input order; it only chooses the fixed output shape.
Transform controls affect only the overlay input, not both inputs.
Multiplying by black drives output black, so masks and levels matter upstream.
legacyxform changes rotation and transform-order behavior in old networks.
key_concepts: Multiplies Input1 and Input2 as a two-input image composite.
Fixed Layer chooses the output resolution/aspect source without changing the multiply input order.
The non-fixed input is the overlay affected by prefit, justify, extend, and transform controls.
Native Resolution prefit helps preserve pixel-accurate overlay sampling.
The operator supports 3D Textures and 2D Texture Arrays.
